# RobAid

> > RobAid is a news and information platform covering robotics, gadgets, technology, bionics, and green architecture innovations.

RobAid aggregates cutting-edge developments in robotics, nanotechnology, biomedical devices, wearables, and sustainable architecture. The site features research from leading institutions like EPFL, RIKEN, KAIST, and MIT, with a focus on emerging technologies that bridge engineering, materials science, and biomimicry.

## Key Topics

- Robotics
- Nanotechnology
- Bionics
- Energy Harvesting
- Green Architecture
- Wearable Technology
- Medical Devices
- Sustainable Design
- Materials Science
- Smart Glasses
- Nanogenerators
- Biomedical Innovation
- EPFL
- KAIST
- Biomimicry

## Robotics & Automation

- [Robotics Archives](https://www.robaid.com/robotics): Robotics news archive covering robot learning, deep-sea and educational robots

## Wearables & Gadgets

- [Gadgets Archives](https://www.robaid.com/gadgets): Gadgets archive featuring wearables, medical devices and smart glasses
- [Eyes-On Glasses System – vein detection eyewear](https://www.robaid.com/gadgets/eyes-on-glasses-system-vein-detection-eyewear.htm): Article on Evena Medical's augmented reality smart glasses for vein detection

## Nanotechnology & Materials Science

- [Tech Archives](https://www.robaid.com/tech): Tech news archive covering nanotechnology, bionics and materials science
- [More efficient hybrid nanowire–nanoparticle palladium catalyst](https://www.robaid.com/tech/more-efficient-hybrid-nanowire-nanoparticle-palladium-catalyst.htm): Article on RIKEN's palladium catalyst for efficient carbon bond formation
- [Improving optical fiber bandwidth by a factor of ten](https://www.robaid.com/tech/improving-optical-fiber-throughput-by-a-factor-of-ten.htm): Article on EPFL's optical fiber bandwidth improvement using Nyquist pulses
- [Using carbon nanofibers to improve synthetic gasoline production](https://www.robaid.com/tech/using-carbon-nanofibers-to-improve-synthetic-gasoline-production.htm): Article on UIC's carbon nanofiber catalyst for synthetic fuel production
- [Packaging made from tomato by-product waste](https://www.robaid.com/tech/packaging-made-from-tomato-by-product-waste.htm): Article on sustainable bio-based packaging from tomato waste byproducts

## Bionics & Energy Harvesting

- [Bionics Archives](https://www.robaid.com/bionics): Bionics archive featuring biomedical devices, energy harvesting and biomimicry
- [Lab on a chip for sweat testing and monitoring](https://www.robaid.com/bionics/lab-on-a-chip-for-sweat-testing.htm): Article on EPFL's lab-on-chip nanosensor technology for health monitoring
- [Virus-templated fabrication of piezoelectric nanogenerators](https://www.robaid.com/bionics/virus-templated-fabrication-of-piezoelectric-nanogenerators.htm): Article on KAIST's virus-templated energy harvesting nanogenerators

## Green Architecture & Sustainability

- [Architecture Archives](https://www.robaid.com/architecture): Green architecture archive covering sustainable design and solar technology
- [EPFL's new convention center west façade features dye solar cells](https://www.robaid.com/tech/epfls-new-convention-center-west-facade-features-dye-solar-cells.htm): Article on EPFL's building-integrated dye solar cell architecture innovation
